results.fact: Rope needed for the Upper Saddle rappel
results.correct_value: a single 60 m rope is enough if you trend right from the slung horn
results.evidence: Mountain Project commenters say 60 m is sufficient and the rappel can be done in one pull from the slung horn; a trip report states a 60 m dynamic line was enough for both raps. descent_text already says this, so the two gear lines are corrected. [Lead review: a 60 m only just reaches (SummitPost: barely, keep right; MP: 70 m comfortable), so gear[1] keeps the 70 m recommendation and gear[2] now says the 60 m only just reaches.]

patches.fact: Rope needed for the Upper Saddle rappel
patches.find: A 60 m rope is too short for that rappel in one go and forces a stop at an intermediate anchor in Sargent's Chimney
patches.replace: A 60 m rope only just reaches: rappel from the slung horn and trend right, or stop at an intermediate anchor in Sargent's Chimney

results.correct_value: Lower Saddle about 6 mi; summit about 8 mi one way
results.evidence: Round-trip figures for the full route are 16.2 and 16.3 mi (about 8 mi each way), and Lupine Meadows to Lower Saddle is 12.3-12.6 mi round trip (about 6 mi one way). The row's 7 mi summit and 6.5-7 mi saddle figures were too close together. [Lead review: approach 6.5-7 mi saddle range kept (published figures vary 6.2-7); summit distMi 8 matches 16 mi round trip.]
